subject: Pilot terms clarification: sandbox credits & pricing floor
messages:
From: Dr. Anika Rao <anika.rao@novahealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot terms clarification: sandbox credits & pricing floor

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost breakdown you showed are promising.

We're preparing an internal RFP bake-off and senior leadership has asked for two clarifications before procurement moves forward:

1) Trial credits: can Redwood provide a supplemental pool for our benchmark run? Our data science team estimates ~120k token-equivalents across parallel tests; your standard pilot allotment looks smaller.
2) Pricing floor: if we sign a 6-month dedicated pilot after the bake-off, do you enforce a minimum committed rate or is there flexibility for a scaled ramp?

Procurement timeline: target to have vendor terms selected by next Friday (2026-12-10). If you can confirm credit uplift and an indicative pricing-floor cap (or confirm no floor), that would help us finalize the short-list.

Thanks,
Dr. Anika Rao
VP, Data & AI
NovaHealth

P.S. copying procurement on the thread for visibility: procurement@novahealth.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Anika Rao <anika.rao@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot terms clarification: sandbox credits & pricing floor

Anika — really appreciate the clear asks. Quick responses below and a proposal to keep the bake-off competitive: 

1) Trial credits: we can offer a one-time pilot supplement of 150k token-equivalents earmarked for the bake-off (one month validity). That should cover parallel tests and edge-case prompts.

2) Pricing floor: for a 6-month dedicated pilot we typically discuss a minimum committed throughput, not a hard dollar floor. However, for customers coming out of an RFP bake-off we can provide a capped pricing commitment: if you convert to Dedicated within 45 days post-bakeoff, we'll guarantee no higher per-token rate than X (I can share a non-binding range now and firm it once we agree on model/quant).

Next steps I'd propose: I can circulate a short SOW and mutually agreed MA/PoC milestone list; Ben and Grace (copied) will help with usage tracking and SLO guardrails. If that sounds good I can send the SOW draft and a simple clause on the post-bakeoff pricing cap.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: NovaHealth — discretionary credit uplift request (DEAL-78934)

Jonas / Kimberly — following up on Jonas's note. NovaHealth is asking for a 150k token uplift for the bake-off. Our standard pilot is 50k; anything above 100k requires pricing ops approval.

Rationale: large parallel tests, potential enterprise conversion, strategic in-healthcare vertical. Risk: if they don't convert we'll be provisioning credits that might not convert to revenue.

Requesting: Kimberly — do you have latitude to approve a 150k uplift as a one-time discretionary pilot subsidy? If not full approve, would a 100k uplift + conditional additional 50k on milestone look OK?

I attached last week's usage report from the demo sandbox for context.

[Attachment: novahealth_usage_report_dec2026.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

Thanks,
Ben
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: NovaHealth — discretionary credit uplift request (DEAL-78934)

Ben / Jonas — thanks for the context. Approve the following carve-out:

- Upfront pilot credit: 100k token-equivalents granted immediately.
- Conditional top-up: additional 50k available upon completion of a short benchmark milestone (our SRE/CS must see a 2-day run with error rate <1.5% and sequence-length profile as documented).
- Commercial guardrail: include a capped pricing commitment in the SOW: if they execute Dedicated within 45 days, max per-token rate will not exceed our non-discounted IA tier + 12%.

Please include a short marketing reference to credit subsidy in the SOW (we'll use for internal reporting), and route the final SOW to Finance for approval on the cost center before sending externally.

I've attached a SOW template with the clause placeholders.

[Attachment: NovaHealth_SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 48KB)]

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Pricing & Commercial Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Anika Rao <anika.rao@novahealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@novahealth.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot terms clarification: sandbox credits & pricing floor

Anika — great news: we can proceed with a two-part offer for the RFP bake-off. Summary below and attached a short SOW draft for review.

Offer summary (for bake-off):
- Pilot credits: 100k token-equivalents provided upfront; conditional additional 50k after a benchmark milestone (2-day run, error rate <1.5%).
- Validity: credits usable for 30 days from issuance; top-up will be active for 14 days after milestone verification.
- Pricing commitment: if NovaHealth converts to a 6-month Dedicated within 45 days of bake-off completion, Redwood guarantees per-token rate no higher than our IA tier + 12% (model & quantization to be specified in final SOW).

Attached: short SOW draft with the credit subsidy clause and the milestone definition. Please review and flag any procurement/legal edits. If this aligns with procurement timelines I'll get Finance to approve cost recognition and then send a DocuSign-ready SOW.

Next steps:
1) Procurement — review SOW and confirm procurement timeline.
2) Once SOW sign-off, we'll issue the upfront 100k credits and schedule the benchmark window with Grace's team.

Thanks — copying Ben and Grace.

Attachment: NovaHealth_SOW_draft.pdf (see attached)

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pilot terms clarification: sandbox credits & pricing floor

Jonas / Ben — thanks for the clarity and SOW draft. Procurement can move forward on the proposed structure. A couple of quick items from our side:

- We accept the 100k upfront + conditional 50k topology contingent on the milestone verification.
- Please add a standard data-processing addendum clause (we'll send our DPA redline later today).
- For the pricing commitment, procurement requests the exact numeric range you referenced during the demo be added as a non-binding exhibit in the SOW (helps our budget gating).

Request: please route the finalized SOW via DocuSign and include a simple checklist of deliverables and the benchmark window so our data team can lock resources.

Once we have the DocuSign link we can get the PO and signatures; target to sign by 2026-12-12 if SOW edits are minor.

Appreciate the responsiveness.
